metadata.title: Indie Pop Album Cover with Layered Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A full-body studio portrait featuring a subject in casual urban attire with three distinct layers of typography: hand-drawn script, bold block lettering, and a reflective floor effect.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered full-body portrait of a woman in a red plaid shirt and distressed black jeans against a neutral grey studio wall, featuring a complex typographic stack where hand-drawn black ink lettering overlaps large, white, bold sans-serif capitals at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically with feet touching the bottom typographic layer
Hand-drawn black text positioned at the subject's waist level
Large white block text anchored to the bottom edge
Subtle floor reflection mirroring the subject and the bottom text
coreInvariants: High-contrast red and black plaid pattern on the upper garment
Neutral cool-grey background with soft studio lighting
Three-tier typographic hierarchy with varying weights and styles

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body subject centered horizontally, occupying the middle 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white block lettering at the bottom serves as a heavy visual base.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move down the red plaid shirt to the black script, and finally rest on the large white block text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample neutral grey space to the left and right of the subject to allow for typographic breathing room.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral grey background and black denim providing a muted canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red in the plaid shirt acts as the primary focal point.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the bottom typography to ensure legibility against the grey.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the shirt against low saturation surroundings; high value contrast between white text and dark clothing.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Combination of organic brush script and geometric sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Top layer: Hand-drawn, irregular stroke widths, ink-bleed texture, slanted.
Bottom layer: Uniform stroke width, high-impact geometric blocks, no serifs.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script 'A' has a long, expressive crossbar.
The block 'W' and 'A' in the bottom layer have sharp, pointed vertices.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, dark organic script paired with rigid, light geometric blocks for maximum stylistic tension.

preserve: The contrast between the messy script and the clean block text
avoid: Using a standard cursive font for the script
Placing text entirely off the subject

candidateDirections.reason: To capture the raw, hand-drawn energy of the top layer.
To provide the heavy, stable base for the bottom layer.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-body studio portrait of a woman with curly hair wearing a red and black plaid shirt and black ripped jeans, standing against a plain grey wall with a reflective floor.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold white sans-serif block text at the bottom. Overlap this with hand-drawn black marker-style script text positioned near the center-left.

verificationChecks: Is the script text black and hand-drawn in appearance?
Is the bottom text white, bold, and sans-serif?
Does the subject wear a red plaid shirt?
Is there a subtle reflection on the floor?

mustRedesign: Do not use the specific artist name or album title
Do not replicate the exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Clean studio lighting with soft shadows
Sharp typographic edges for the block text
Authentic ink-like texture for the script
avoid: Clashing colors outside the red/black/white/grey scheme

postGenerationChecks: Check that the black script overlaps the subject's clothing.
Ensure the white block text is partially obscured by the subject's boots.
Verify the floor reflection includes both the subject and the white text.
Confirm the plaid shirt is the only high-saturation element.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Plaid Focal Point + Layered Script/Block Typography + Reflective Floor
